laws.rule: Kyoto City accommodation tax from 1 March 2026, per person per night by room rate: under JPY 6,000 pays JPY 200; JPY 6,000 to 19,999 pays JPY 400; JPY 20,000 to 49,999 pays JPY 1,000; JPY 50,000 to 99,999 pays JPY 4,000; JPY 100,000 or more pays JPY 10,000.
laws.heading: Kyoto City accommodation tax (revised March 2026)
